fullPassage: Recently, a study was conducted on the difference in pain tolerance between athletes and non-athletes. The results showed that the athletes were able to tolerate higher levels of pain. According to the researchers, this is because they make use of certain cognitive strategies to deal with the pain. Another strategy is one in which athletes focus on a positive thought to distract them from negative feelings of pain. The researchers believe that this kind of resistance to pain is something that can be learned over time.
